reviewTitle: Survived a 6-Month Spiritual Retreat in My Garden and Came Back Stronger
reviewDescription: About 6 months ago, I lost the charging/storage case for my beloved earbuds. Vanished. Gone. I tore apart my house like a raccoon with a vendetta; checked pockets, bags, under furniture, questioned my life choices… nothing. Fast forward to today: I’m out in the garden, living my best “I should probably touch grass” life, pulling weeds… and THERE IT IS. In the dirt. Buried. Like a tiny plastic time capsule of my own irresponsibility. This thing has apparently been out there since September. Through weather. Through seasons. Through what I can only assume was a full emotional journey. Naturally, I assumed it was dead. Gone to the great electronics graveyard in the sky. But no. I cleaned it off, charged it… and IT WORKS. Perfectly. Like it just got back from a spa retreat and is now spiritually aligned and ready to serve. At this point, I’m not convinced this is a charging case. I think it’s a Nokia from 2003 in disguise. If you’re looking for a product that: Survives being buried alive for half a year Thrives in dirt like a root vegetable Laughs in the face of moisture, time, and neglect …this is the one.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on April 12, 2026
